book.name: Sekan Kranakuls
book.title: Sekan Kranakuls Ola Stori Blanga Ola King Blanga Juda

content: King Salaman bin gitredi blanga bildimap det Serramoni Pleis langa Jerusalem
King Salaman bin jinggabat blanga bildimap serramoni pleis blanga weshipbat langa YAWEI, en imbin jinggabat blanga bildimap im ronwan haus du.
King Salaman bin pikimat 70,000 men blanga garrimap ola ebrijing, en 80,000 men blanga kadimbat ola ston ontop langa det hil kantri. En 3,600 najalot men bin jidan boswan lida blanga det wek.
King Salaman bin jandim leda langa King Hairam langa Taya. Imbin dalim im, “Yu album mi laik yubin album main dedi Deibid wen yubin gibit im det sidatri wud blanga bildimap im gudwan haus.

Ai garra bildimapbat wanbala serramoni pleis blanga weshipbat YAWEI. Dijan pleis garra jidan seikridwan blanga mi en main pipul olabat blanga weshipbat langa YAWEI na. Melabat garra barnimap det gudsmelwan medisin en gibit det speshalwan damba blanga im olataim en melabat garra gibit barnapwan ofring ebri ailibala en ebri aftanun en ebri Sebathdei, en langa ebri Nyumanth serramoni en najalot holiwan dei, blanga preisimbat YAWEI, melabat God. Imbin dalim ola Isreil pipul blanga dum dislot ting olataim.
Ai garra bildimap brabli gudwan serramoni pleis, dumaji melabat God mowa haibala brom eni najalot drimin.
Bat nobodi kaan bildimap serramoni pleis blanga God, dumaji det skai im lilwan langa im. Ai gin oni bildimap speshalwan pleis blanga gibit sekrifais ofring langa God.

Wal yu jandim wanbala men hu sabi hau blanga kadimbat en meigim pitja garram gol, silba, kopa en aiyan, en blanga meigimbat bluwan, pepulwan en redwan matiriyal. Im garra wek garram detlot men hu wek gudwei garram bingga brom Juda en Jerusalem weya main dedi bin pikimat longtaim.

Ai sabi yu garram loda brabli klebabala men hu gin wek gudwei garram timba. Wal yu jandim langa mi sidatri, paintri en junipa timba brom Lebanan. Ai garra jandim main wekinmen olabat deya blanga album yu wekinmen olabat,
weya dei garra meigim redi loda timba. Dumaji dijan serramoni pleis weya ai garra bildimap garra jidan brabli bigwan en brabli purdiwan.
Ai garra jandim daga blanga yu wekinmenmob, 2,000 tan sid daga gulum wit, 2,000 tan sid daga gulum bali, 400,000 lita wain, en 400,000 lita oliboil.” Lagijat na King Salaman bin tok langa det leda.
Wal King Hairam bin jandimbek leda langa King Salaman. Imbin dalim im, “Dumaji YAWEI laigim im pipul olabat detmatj, imbin meigim yu jidan king blanga olabat.

Preisimbat YAWEI det God blanga Isreil. Im na bin meigim skai en graun. Imbin gibit King Deibid brabli klebawan san hu sabi ebrijing wanim im garra dum. Im na garra bildimap serramoni pleis blanga YAWEI en haus blanga im ronselp.
Mi jandimbat yu brabli klebawan wekinmen neim Huram hu sabi meigimbat ebrijing brabli gudwei.

Im mami bin brom det klen blanga Den en im dedi bin kaman brom Taya. Im sabi hau blanga meigim ebrijing brom gol, silba, kopa, aiyan, ston en wud. Im sabi hau blanga meigim bluwan, pepulwan en redwan matiriyal en brabli gudwan matiriyal. Im gin kadimbat pitja eniwei yu dalim im. Im garra wek garram ola wekinmen blanga yu en detlot hubin wek garram yu dedi King Deibid.
Wal yu jandim detlot sid daga gulum wit en bali, en det wain en oliboil weya yubin pramisim.

Brom detlot bigwan hil langa Lebanan wi garra kadimdan ola sidatri yu wandim. Wi garra taiyimap holbit en pudum langa solwoda, wulijim dei gin flout olawei langa Jopa. Brom deya yu gin deigim langa Jerusalem.” Lagijat na King Hairam bin raidimbat det leda.
Deibin stat bildimbat det Serramoni Pleis
Wal King Salaman bin kaundimap ola pipul brom najalot kantri hubin jidan langa Isreil, jis laik im dedi Deibid bin dum. Deibin kaundimap 153,600 pipul hubin jidan deya.
Imbin kadimat brom detlot 70,000 pipul blanga garrimap ola ebrijing, en 80,000 pipul blanga kadimap ola ston langa detlot bigwan hil en 3,600 boswan lida blanga det wek.

footnotes.text: Yu gin faindim det mep blanga det Serramoni Pleis langa Fes Kings 6:6.
